presentation.label: PAD SELECT
presentation.summary: With PAD+TRIG SEL TRK checked, a pad press selects its track silently, even in LIVE RECORDING; FUNC + pad plays (and records), and holding a pad down still sends aftertouch.
presentation.overview: Pad Select adds PAD+TRIG SEL TRK to GLOBAL > CONTROL > SEQUENCER CONFIG, a checkbox after AUTO TRK SWITCH. Checked, a pad press selects its track and stays silent, with no MIDI note and nothing recorded, in every state but STEP RECORDING. Hold FUNC and press the pad to play it at the pad's own velocity; in LIVE RECORDING that also records. TRIG keys 1-12 select silently too, but play and record as stock in LIVE and STEP RECORDING. Aftertouch is untouched, so a held pad modulates its track without sounding it. Unchecked, everything is stock. The setting is kept per GLOBAL slot and saved with the project.
highlights: Tap pads to pick tracks without hearing them, even while live recording.
FUNC + pad plays and records, at the pad's own velocity.
Hold a pad down to modulate its sound with aftertouch, silently.
One checkbox per GLOBAL slot, kept through a power cycle; unchecked is stock.
usage: Use a build containing Pad Select. Open the GLOBAL menu, then CONTROL > SEQUENCER CONFIG, and check PAD+TRIG SEL TRK, just after AUTO TRK SWITCH, with YES or LEFT/RIGHT.
With the sequencer stopped, tap the SD pad: it makes no sound and the SD track is selected. Hold FUNC and tap SD to hear it at the pad's own velocity. TRIG 5 selects track 5 silently.
Press RECORD + PLAY for LIVE RECORDING: plain pad taps stay silent and record nothing; hold FUNC and tap a pad to play and record it. Uncheck PAD+TRIG SEL TRK to get stock behaviour everywhere.

access.location: GLOBAL > CONTROL > SEQUENCER CONFIG: PAD+TRIG SEL TRK, after AUTO TRK SWITCH.
steps: Open the GLOBAL menu and choose CONTROL, then SEQUENCER CONFIG.
Move to PAD+TRIG SEL TRK, after AUTO TRK SWITCH, and press YES (or RIGHT) to check it.

controls.name: PAD+TRIG SEL TRK
controls.doc: Checkbox in GLOBAL > CONTROL > SEQUENCER CONFIG, after AUTO TRK SWITCH. YES toggles it, RIGHT checks, LEFT unchecks. Checked: pads select their track silently outside STEP RECORDING, TRIG keys 1-12 outside LIVE and STEP RECORDING. Kept per GLOBAL slot.

controls.name: FUNC + pad
controls.doc: While PAD+TRIG SEL TRK applies, plays the pad's track at the strike's velocity, or the fixed velocity with FIX on (stock FUNC + pad uses the TRIG page's VEL); records it in LIVE RECORDING; selects the track only if AUTO TRK SWITCH is checked, as stock.

controls.name: Pad held down
controls.doc: Aftertouch, as stock: modulates the track's AFTERTOUCH destinations and sends MIDI poly pressure, also after a silent press.

limitations: Built for OS 1.74 only, with core-ar2 0.3.
0.4.0 has run in rytm-emu only; 0.3.0 ran on a unit.
FUNC + TRIG 1-12 plays nothing, as on stock: use FUNC + pad to hear a track.
A silent press passes its aftertouch on, so MIDI out can carry poly pressure with no note-on before it.
TRIG 13 (the FX track), the SOUND BROWSER's pad audition and pads with a menu open are silent too; FUNC + pad plays.
RTRG + pad selects silently; FUNC + RTRG also toggles the metronome click, as on stock, so it is not a clean way to roll.
A GLOBAL slot saved without the setting, or received as Global SysEx, loads unchecked.

claims: ui:GLOBAL > CONTROL > SEQUENCER CONFIG row after AUTO TRK SWITCH

load.display: None in the audio path: a few compares per pad or TRIG key press
load.conditions: Static: the sites are in KeyboardView's pad and TRIG key handlers, their shared play routine and the SEQUENCER CONFIG menu's constructor; each press reads one storage bit and the record state. Nothing is added to the audio, sequencer or tick paths. Not a measurement.

tests.summary: Emulator (rytm-emu c5732f0, OS 1.74, build PS05), against stock from matched snapshots: checked, pads select silently outside STEP REC (LIVE REC included, recording nothing) and TRIG keys outside LIVE and STEP REC; FUNC + pad plays at the strike's velocity, records in LIVE REC and follows AUTO TRK SWITCH; aftertouch as stock; unchecked matches stock exactly. 0.3.0 (PS04) ran on a unit: silent pads, FUNC + pad, power cycle and GLOBAL slots as reported.
